config.design: Five task-specific 2x2 format factorials, eight discovery pairs and eight lexical-transfer pairs; both answer endpoints plus answer-preserving nuisance versions. Original H581 failures remain recorded. Some factorial cells repeat H581 prompts; new combinations are not claimed globally novel.
config.gate: >=4 pairs; both-endpoint candidate accuracy >=.75; intended answer-group full-vocabulary top1 >=.5. Report nuisance separately.
config.selection: Choose lexicographically first passing discovery condition from 00,01,10,11, before inspecting transfer scores. If none passes, none selected. All cells retained.
config.scope: Changes can alter computation as well as answer boundary. Factorial effects are conditional on each task and do not isolate a universal formatting variable. Candidate groups fixed from H533; no post-result expansion.
hypotheses: Recall boundary completion should improve direct answer token generation.
Sentiment cue words interact rather than acting as universal format decoration.
Agreement and binding failures need not be solved by small wording changes.
A discovery-passing condition may fail lexical transfer.
